overviewPage.logsKeepsWhatYourHosts: Logs keeps what your hosts and services write, and finds it again.
overviewPage.addASourceForEach: Add a source for each way logs reach you: shippers such as Vector, Fluent Bit or an OpenTelemetry collector send over HTTP with a token; servers and network devices send syslog; and hosts that send nothing are read over SSH by logs-agent.
overviewPage.whatArrivesFromWhereAnd: What arrives, from where, and what is kept.
overviewPage.victorialogsInsideLogsIsStarting: VictoriaLogs inside Logs is starting or has stopped; it is started again on its own. Lines sent meanwhile are refused, so senders keep and retry them.

settingsPage.savedStorageRestartedWithIt: Saved. Storage restarted with it; lines older than the new retention are removed.
settingsPage.howLongLinesAreKept: How long lines are kept. When the volume fills first, the oldest days go first, so Logs never stops taking lines.
settingsPage.gb0IsUpTo: GB; 0 is up to 90% of the volume

searchesPage.logsHoldPersonalDataAnd: Logs hold personal data and sometimes secrets, so every search and tail is recorded with who ran it, for 400 days. Anyone with the viewer role reads every line Logs keeps.

product.askAnAdminOfThis: Ask an admin of this Logs for access.

explorerPage.searchEveryLineKeptWith: Search every line kept, with LogsQL.

explorerPage.moreMatchNarrowTheQuery: More match: narrow the query or the range
explorerPage.noLinesMatchWidenThe: No lines match. Widen the time range, or check the query.

keyCheck.onTheHostThisMust: On the host, this must print the same fingerprint:
keyCheck.commandToRunOnThe: Command to run on the host
keyCheck.forThisHostAndThe: for this host, and the host presents another key. Check the host; if the key is right, change hostKey in the file.

hostsPage.stopReadingItsLinesStay: Stop reading {{name}}? Its lines stay until retention removes them.
hostsPage.serversLogsAgentReadsOver: Servers logs-agent reads over SSH: the system journal, and container logs where switched on. Nothing is installed on them.
hostsPage.logsAgentIsInstalledOnce: logs-agent is installed once per network and reads the hosts there. Hosts that already send their logs need no agent: add a source for them instead.
hostsPage.theHostsFromItsLast: {{error}}The hosts from its last good version stay until it is fixed ({{path}}).
hostsPage.theHostsFileIsNot: The hosts file is not applied
hostsPage.theHostsFileHasSomething: The hosts file has something to fix
hostsPage.noHostsYetPrepareOne: Prepare a host with the commands under Agents, then list it in the hosts file the install keeps (OPENASY_HOSTS), which Infrastructure and the other products read too, such as:
hostsPage.addedHereBefore_one: {{count}} host was added here before the file
hostsPage.addedHereBefore_other: {{count}} hosts were added here before the file
hostsPage.copyTheseIntoTheHostsFile: They keep being read. Copy these lines into the hosts file: once an entry has the same name, it takes the host over with its pipeline and trusted key.

enrollCommand.startTheAgentWithThis: Start the agent with this one-time token
enrollCommand.itWorksOnceUntilAnd: It works once, until {{value}}, and is not shown again.
enrollCommand.withTheComposeFileOf: With the compose file of Logs:
enrollCommand.startTheAgentNextTo: Start the agent next to Logs
enrollCommand.inAnotherNetworkOnAny: In another network, on any server that reaches the hosts there and reaches Logs:
enrollCommand.startTheAgentInAnother: Start the agent in another network
enrollCommand.closingThisDialogHidesThe: Closing this dialog hides the token
enrollCommand.ifItIsLostEnrol: If it is lost, enrol the agent again from its row.

agentsPage.enrolAgainItsSecretStops: Enrol {{name}} again? Its secret stops working; if its CA changes, the hosts it reads must trust the new one.
agentsPage.logsAgentIsInstalledOnce: logs-agent is installed once, next to Logs or in another network, and reads the hosts there over SSH with 5-minute certificates. It keeps its SSH certificate authority; Logs only says which host to read and from where.
agentsPage.nameItAfterWhereIt: Name it after where it runs. You get a one-time token to start it with.
agentsPage.name: Name
agentsPage.runAsRootOnEach: Run as root on each host {{name}} reads. It creates the openasy account, trusts the agent's CA for that account only, and lets it read the system journal. Nothing else is installed.
agentsPage.orWhereSshdConfigCannot: Or, where sshd_config cannot change, one fixed key that can open no TTY and forward nothing:

pipelineEditor.eachLineGoesThroughThese: Each line goes through these steps in order before it is stored. What is masked or dropped here never reaches the disk.
pipelineEditor.noStepsLinesAreStored: No steps: lines are stored as they arrive.
pipelineEditor.tryItOnSampleLines: Try it on sample lines, one per line
pipelineEditor.whatThePipelineMakesOf: What the pipeline makes of the samples

httpSetup.useTheShipperYouAlready: Use the shipper you already run. Every request carries the source's token; gzip is welcome.

syslogSetup.startLogsWithoutLogsSyslog: {{error}}Start Logs without LOGS_SYSLOG=false to take syslog.
syslogSetup.fromSyslogCarriesNoToken: From {{value}}. Syslog carries no token: the address a message comes from says which source it belongs to.
syslogSetup.sendersTrustItBecauseYou: Senders trust it because you copy it to them. To use one from your own CA, mount it and set LOGS_SYSLOG_TLS_CERT_FILE and LOGS_SYSLOG_TLS_KEY_FILE.
syslogSetup.tcpRfc5424OrRfc: {{host}}:{{tlsPort}}, TCP, RFC 5424 or RFC 3164, octet-counted or one message per line

sourcePage.aNewTokenTheCurrent: A new token? The current one stops working at once.
sourcePage.itIsShownOncePut: It is shown once. Put it where the old one was; the old one no longer works.
sourcePage.closingThisDialogHidesThe: Closing this dialog hides the token
sourcePage.offSendersAreRefusedAnd: Off: senders are refused and nothing is stored.
sourcePage.addressesOrNetworksSeparatedBy: Addresses or networks, separated by commas
sourcePage.forDevicesThatCannotDo: For devices that cannot do TLS. Anyone on these networks can then send, and read nothing back.
sourcePage.logsAgentReadsJournaldAnd: logs-agent reads journald and Docker on the hosts under

addSource.name: Name
addSource.storedAsTheSourceField: Stored as the source field of each line
addSource.syslogCarriesNoTokenOnly: Syslog carries no token: only these senders are taken.

sourcesPage.whereLogsComeFromSent: Where logs come from: sent by shippers with a token, by syslog from known networks, or read over SSH. Each source has its pipeline.
sourcesPage.itIsShownOnceThe: It is shown once. The snippets already hold it; use the shipper you already run.
sourcesPage.closingThisDialogHidesThe: Closing this dialog hides the token
sourcesPage.ifItIsLostMake: If it is lost, make a new one on the source's page.
sourcesPage.addOneForEachWay: Add one for each way logs reach you: shippers over HTTP, syslog from devices, or hosts read over SSH.

tailPage.linesSentToLogsAppear: Lines sent to Logs appear within seconds; lines read over SSH arrive at each host's interval.
tailPage.logsIsReconnectingIfIt: Logs is reconnecting. If it keeps stopping, check the query in Explorer: a query Logs cannot run is refused here too.

viewForm.name: Name
viewForm.callAWebhookWhenIt: Call a webhook when it crosses a threshold
viewForm.checkedEveryMinuteTheWebhook: Checked every minute. The webhook is called when more lines match than the threshold, and again when it is back under.

viewsPage.queriesKeptForLaterShared: Queries kept for later. Shared views are seen by everyone; a threshold calls a signed webhook, such as Alerts, Slack through a relay, or your own service.
viewsPage.itIsShownOnceCalls: It is shown once. Calls carry webhook-id, webhook-timestamp and webhook-signature headers (Standard Webhooks): check the signature with this secret before you trust a call.
viewsPage.closingThisDialogHidesThe: Closing this dialog hides the secret
viewsPage.searchInExplorerThenSave: Search in Explorer, then Save view; or add one here.
